{{Top}}
A '''Force artifact''', also known as '''Force relic''',<ref name="COE 2">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref> '''Force talisman''',<ref name="RCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> or '''dark side talisman''' when associated with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]],<ref name="Komari">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021121komari|text=Komari Vosa}}</ref> was a physical item with the ability to magnify [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for someone who knew how to use it.<ref name="COE 2" /> was imbued with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by a [[Force Adept|Force adept]]. The imbued item was usually of personal significance to the adept and could be used to protect the adept from other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]].<ref name="RCR" /> [[Komari Vosa]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the leader of the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]], had a Force talisman.<ref name="Komari" /> Some members of the [[Wyrd]], a group of dark side [[Tarasin]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], including the senior witch [[Xinishia]], carried Force talismans.<ref name="From the Trees">{{LivingForce|From the Trees}}</ref>
